text:
zoe.marketing: Draft posted at https://docs.redwood.ai/launch-draft-v3. Main asks: tighten hero to a data-linked claim, surface benchmark snapshot below hero, confirm webinar CTA copy and registration tiers + UTMs. Quick eyes by 4pm PT please.

mike.prod: Love the structure. Proposal for hero: 'Redwood Inference: predictable LLM serving that can reduce per-token costs by up to ~40% on common batch/latency profiles.' Add short stat line under hero.

tara.content: Agreed. Put a small callout card: 'Benchmark snapshot: up to ~40% lower per-token cost vs baseline single-instance serving*' then link footnote. Tone down hype words.

olivia.legal: Quick pass: use 'can reduce' and keep 'up to'. Footnote required: '*Benchmarks run on Redwood internal workloads; results vary by model, sequence length, and batch size. See appendix for methodology and run dates.' Also add a privacy note near the form: 'By registering you consent to contact from Redwood; data stored in HubSpot per our privacy policy.'

james.growth: UTMs: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=product_launch_q2`. Add hidden field `launch_interest` and registration select: [Attend live, Watch recording, Pilot/case-study interest]. I'll map to HubSpot.

marco.design: I'll create a small stat card under the hero and a CTA button. Need exact CTA text + 2-line "what you'll learn".

tara.content: Draft CTA: 'Register: Live launch walkthrough + cost playbook'
What you'll learn:
- Unit-cost levers and benchmark context
- Deployment checklist for Dedicated & Private 
- Live demo + Q&A (product team)
Form mapping and privacy note included.

mike.prod: Appendix checklist for benchmarks: model family, seq lengths, batch sizes, hardware, Optimize toggles (caching, quant).

olivia.legal: Approved with footnote & privacy note. No competitor names without public citation.

james.growth: Approved on UTMs and form fields. I'll create the HubSpot mapping after publish lock.

publish-bot: Reminder: publish window opens in 24h. Final approvals due by 4pm PT to hit slot.

zoe.marketing: Thanks all ":tada:" locking content at 4pm unless objections. Kicking design + HubSpot handoff once locked.
